fn main() {
    let (sender, receiver) = async_channel::bounded(1);
    let worker = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        sender.send_blocking(17u32).unwrap();
        sender.send_blocking(23u32).unwrap();
    });
    assert_eq!(receiver.recv_blocking().unwrap(), 17);
    assert_eq!(receiver.recv_blocking().unwrap(), 23);
    worker.join().unwrap();
    assert!(receiver.recv_blocking().is_err());
    let (sender, receiver) = async_channel::unbounded();
    sender.send_blocking(31u32).unwrap();
    let other = receiver.clone();
    assert_eq!(other.try_recv().unwrap(), 31);
    assert!(receiver.try_recv().is_err());
    sender.close();
    assert!(sender.send_blocking(47).is_err());
    assert!(receiver.is_closed());
    println!("async-channel blocking and closure complete");
}
